subject: Request: Accelerator trial stretch + promotional incentive for demo week
body:
From: Sasha Levin <sasha@alphabox.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator cohort — request to stretch trial + promotional support

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Alphabox is excited to proceed with the accelerator cohort. We have a demo week with three potential pilot partners on Sep 17 and are likely to spike usage for a short window. Two asks from our side:

- Can Redwood extend the 30-day trial to 60 days for our account? We want to include the extended window as part of the cohort offer.
- Can you provide a $2,500 promotional credit that we can allocate across the demo week (roughly Sep 16–18)?

We can sign a short SOW and provide the usage estimate; attaching the draft SOW and a quick CSV of expected token usage.

Appreciate your help — we want to keep momentum with the cohort and make sure we can show partners a smooth experience. If there are constraints, a partial extension (to 45 days) would still help.

Best,
Sasha Levin
CEO, Alphabox Labs

---
Attachment: Alphabox_SOW_Draft_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: trial-usage-estimate.csv (text/csv)

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Sasha Levin <sasha@alphabox.ai>
To: legal@alphabox.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Accelerator cohort — request to stretch trial + promotional support

Forwarding the note to loop in legal on the SOW language we discussed.

-----

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Levin <sasha@alphabox.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort — request to stretch trial + promotional support

Hi Sasha — great to meet yesterday, and thanks for the materials.

We can almost always accommodate short promotional supports like this, but I need to confirm a couple of details before I route for approval:

1) Confirm which Redwoods sub-account will receive the extension and credit (team vs. central org).
2) Expected peak tokens per minute and total token estimate for Sep 16–18 (I can take the CSV but a short call would speed things up).
3) Will the promotional credit be applied to billed usage or be provided as a waived-invoice credit?

If it's fine, can you reply with a one-line confirmation for 1 and 3 and I’ll schedule a quick 15-min sync today to validate the usage numbers? I’ll loop Marcus (sales lead) and Ben (account rep) if we need an exception to standard trial timelines.

Thanks — K

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

On Thu, Sep 3, 2026 at 11:02 AM Sasha Levin <sasha@alphabox.ai> wrote:
> Hi Kimberly — quick answers:
>
> 1) We'll use the cohort-managed sub-account (alphabox-cohort-09).
> 2) Peak estimate: ~12 requests/minute during demos, average 1.2k tokens/request, total estimate attached (~1.1M tokens over the three days).
> 3) Prefer the promotional credit be a waived-invoice credit applied to billed usage; we don't need a separate ledger entry.
>
> Happy to jump on a short call now if that helps.
>
> Sasha
>
> 
From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Levin <sasha@alphabox.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 14:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort — request to stretch trial + promotional support

Thanks for the quick clarifications and the usage file, Sasha — that helps. I’ve reviewed the CSV and the peak/total look reasonable for a short demo spike.

Next steps from our side:
- I’m requesting a 30-day exception (extend from 30 to 60 days) and a $2,500 promotional waived-invoice credit.
- Finance will require the SOW signed and a short note on the HubSpot deal saying the credit is promotional and non-recurring.
- Legal will need to confirm the SOW language; I’ve asked Alphabox to loop legal.

Marcus and Ben — can you help expedite formal approval? If we can get an affirmative by EOD Monday Sep 7 I’ll issue the credit and update the trial window so Sasha’s team is ready for Sep 16. If Finance needs a PO or signed SOW before the credit is applied, please call that out.

Thanks — K

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

On Tue, Sep 7, 2026 at 16:40:00 -0700 Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi team — I reviewed the usage projection and the roadmap for the cohort. Given this is a short-term demo spike and it aligns with our accelerator initiative, I approve:
>
> - Trial stretch to 60 days (one-time exception)
> - Promotional waived-invoice credit: $2,500 (apply to the Sep billing cycle)
>
> Finance: please implement as a waived credit tied to deal DL-2026-0492 and confirm when posted. Ben, please update HubSpot and attach the signed SOW when available.
>
> Sasha — we’ll get this configured and I’ll confirm once Finance posts the credit. Good luck on demo week.
>
> Marcus Lin
> Sales Director | Redwood Inference
